entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: The main continent of the Domains in Dominaria's northern hemisphere, named for an ancient fertility goddess.

entities.name: Aerona (goddess)
entities.description: An ancient fertility goddess who, according to legend, sacrificed herself to let people take crops from her body.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Aerona lies.

entities.name: North Aerona
entities.description: The part of Aerona lying north of Hurloon.

entities.name: South Aerona
entities.description: The largest part of Aerona, south of the isthmus near Hurloon.

entities.name: The Godstone
entities.description: A stone pillar in the woods of North Aerona that can heal, reverse aging, or kill, once worshiped by orcs, dwarves and hill giants.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A gigantic lush forest ruled by elves.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A powerful military-forward nation, former location of the Sheoltun Empire.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: A vast, magical forest of echoing whispers in North Aerona, home to many sylvan creatures.

entities.name: Janar
entities.description: A city of assassins, formerly known as Hujek.

entities.name: Kaldroom
entities.description: A garrison city destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Mount Canval
entities.description: A chilly three-peaked mountain on the western coast of Aerona.

entities.name: Automatown
entities.description: A bustling mountain settlement of artificers and traders in the Red Iron Mountains.

entities.name: Bethanelle
entities.description: A woman who received the gift of death from her son Necros on Mount Canval.

entities.name: Necros
entities.description: Bethanelle's son, who gave her the gift of death.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A character who settled in a treehouse dwelling in the Whispering Woods.

entities.name: Tobias Andrion
entities.description: Benalia's legendary founder, after whom Andrion Bay is named.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The war in which Kaldroom was destroyed.

events.summary: According to legend, the goddess Aerona sacrificed herself so people could take crops from her body, giving the continent its name.
events.quote: sacrificed herself to let people take crops from her body

events.summary: Orcs, dwarves and hill giants warred over control of the Godstone until it was lost to time and the elements.
events.quote: who warred over who controlled it until it was lost to time and the elements

events.summary: Kaldroom, a garrison city, was destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Kaldroom - a garrison city, destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion .

events.summary: On Mount Canval, Bethanelle finally received the gift of death from her son Necros.
events.quote: where Bethanelle finally received the gift of death from her son Necros
